title: Aljaž Tower
visualBrief: The restored Triglav summit shelter: riveted pale-gray cylindrical shell, eight small viewing windows, closed raised door with hinges and latch, dark conical cap, readable Slovenian plaque, stencil-cut 1895 flag, Y anchors and guy ropes.

nativeAxes.front: +Z doorway and plaque, approximately south at heading0; exact compass phase is not claimed.
nativeAxes.origin: Cylinder axis at the rock-anchor contact plane

scaleBasis: The heritage authority publishes the 1.25 m cylinder diameter, 2 m body and 2.90 m total including the flag support. Its 2025 conservation photographs establish the restored palette, raised door, eight windows, rivet seams, label, stencil flag and anchors. The 2018 intervention preserved all three original Y anchors, original site elevation and rotation. Small fittings and the visible shell/roof proportions are photographic reconstructions.

geographicProposal.evidence: The inspected exterior picture supports the pale cylindrical shelter, dark conical roof, raised doorway, plaque, cut1895 flag and metal anchors/guy ropes. The retained mapped circle supplies location and diameter. Heading0 places the model doorway approximately south; this is an explicit approximate facing choice, not a measured doorway bearing. Standard viewer PMTiles provide the summit working datum 2777.579296317931m. The small original shell/anchor contact plane uses modelY0; coarse summit slope and actual rock details are approximate.
geographicProposal.orientationConfidence: approximate-facing; circular map outline does not determine exact entrance phase
geographicProposal.limitations: Approximate doorway phase and coarse summit ground accepted for this exterior visualization.

appearance.identity: Restored pale cylindrical summit shelter, eight viewing windows, dark conical cap, raised closed doorway, readable plaque, cut 1895 flag and three Y anchors.
appearance.epoch: 2025 heritage-authority conservation photographs; 2018 restoration retained original location and rotation.
appearance.master: Original 23236-triangle detailed source master retained byte-for-byte.
appearance.browser: Skyline keeps the small shelter silhouette and anchor cables; district retains real recessed windows and simplified plaque/flag; street retains the readable plaque, cut stencil flag, all rivets and fittings with fewer regular shell/roof subdivisions; closeup is the complete original.
appearance.exclusions: Visitor interior, copied historical panorama, exact summit rock, fabrication dimensions and exact doorway compass bearing.
